newsitem.title: USA: AMEX, PHLX set options listing for March 3 and 5.
newsitem.headline: AMEX, PHLX set options listing for March 3 and 5.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Friday it would list options on Linens 'n Things Inc on March 3.
Separately, the Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said it would list options on Consumer Portfolio Services Inc on March 5.
The AMEX said Linens 'n Things options would open with strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25, with position limits of 4,500 contracts. Initial expirations are set for March, April, July and October.
The stock was down 1/8 at 21-1/4 Friday afternoon.
The Amex said Charlton, Goin, SLK has been named specialist for the options.

At the PHLX, Consumer Portfolio options would open with strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2 and initial expirations in March, April, May and August. Position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set.
Consumer Portfolio shares were up 1/4 at 10 Friday afternoon.
The PHLX said Susquehanna Investment Group has been named the specialist. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
